inputs.name: WireMessageValidator.request.text
inputs.description: The JSON text of one request frame that the host receives. It is refused as 'too-large' when its UTF-8 length is over its limit (65536 bytes by default), and otherwise must be a JSON object with exactly the fields id, input, method and type.

inputs.name: WireMessageValidator.request.limit
inputs.description: The largest UTF-8 byte length of text that is accepted, which decides when text is refused as 'too-large'; the value itself is not range-checked. Defaults to remoteLimits.requestBytes: 65536 bytes.

inputs.name: WireMessageValidator.message.text
inputs.description: The JSON text of one client-side wire message, which must be a JSON object whose type is 'event' or 'response'. Text over remoteLimits.messageBytes (16777216 UTF-8 bytes) is refused as 'too-large'.

outputs.name: WireMessageValidator.request
outputs.description: The validated request: type 'request', the request id, a method from remoteMethods, and the parsed input object. Only these four fields are returned, and the fields inside input are not checked.

outputs.name: WireMessageValidator.message
outputs.description: A text with type 'event' becomes a WireEvent whose channel is 'run', 'cache' or 'connection' and whose sequence is a safe integer of at least 1. A text with type 'response' becomes a WireResponse that carries value when ok is true, or its RemoteError when ok is false.

error.message: The connection has not been attached.

errors.name: RemoteFailure
errors.description: Code 'too-large': the text's UTF-8 length is over its byte limit (the limit argument for request(), remoteLimits.messageBytes for message()), checked before parsing; no requestId is set.

errors.name: RemoteFailure
errors.description: Code 'invalid-message': the text is not a JSON object, or it does not match any of the three wire shapes (request, response, event) exactly; request() sets requestId whenever the id is valid.

errors.name: RemoteFailure
errors.description: Code 'unknown-method': request() received a request whose id is valid but whose method is not in remoteMethods; the error carries its requestId.
